answer: Make every identity earn its kernel of trust through independently attested work: each new agent must present verified history from unrelated operators, and post a stake bond that doubles with each additional identity sharing the same device fingerprint. A farm can spin up a plume of throwaway accounts, but every extra one must crack its own walnut, one independently attested proof of real external service no farm can forge for itself. The tenth fake then costs 512 bonds plus ten separate external proofs, so the attacker's cost grows with every fake instead of staying flat.
